author: agent:claude
text:

State 9 Nov 2026 ~20:45, branch feat/spillway-ui (from feat/foldrunner-me-build 7698806ef), last commit 0eb2b4436.
- Mike rejected Archivo ("not my fav"), then said not to restrict to his font-tinder history. Picked Bricolage Grotesque (OFL, opsz/wght/wdth axes, tnum). Committed at projects/foldrunner/assets/ui/ with MANIFEST.json + licences/ (picked up by package-r16 licence_files). Specimen: ~/.cache/spillway-r18/specimen/bricolage.png.
- Desktop GPU is NVIDIA RTX 2070 SUPER, not AMD as the brief said. Screenshots use look/desktop-gpu/helpers/desktop-run.py DesktopDisplay (private headless weston + Xwayland on nvidia). Harness: tools/r18-ui-shots.py (stills | run | release) + tools/r18-ui-shots.gd.
- Before tree: git archive 7698806ef in ~/.cache/spillway-r18/before-src (imported). Before stills 1920x1080 done in ~/.cache/spillway-r18/shots/before/ (1440p, ultrawide and mid-run still to do). Staged finish needs a re-stage after frames: session re-calls show_finish.
- BEFORE suites pass: parity (copy of r17-b406 verify-final.py pinned to 7698806ef, REPO=this worktree, ORIGINAL abs path) at ~/foldrunner-build-2026-11-05/look/evidence/r18-ui/parity-before: 8 routes x old/new/toggle ok, audit 299/299, negative 104/104, 475 R16 files preserved. Needed R16 baseline copied from laptop (r17-parity/verified, delivery/spillway-r16/VERIFICATION.json, tapes/references). Visual invariants tests/r17_visual_invariants.gd all 8 maps: 1873 checks, 0 failures (~/.cache/spillway-r18/suites/before-invariants).
Design decisions: keep all R15/R16 HUD fields and their texts (probes match CROUCH, PRACTICE..., 'Best ...', identity, strafe texts); new HUD scripts/r18_hud.gd extends r16_hud, swapped in by r17_main after super._ready (adapter tests/r17_parity.gd loads r17_main, so parity exercises the new UI unchanged); F9 toggles telemetry (identity line, keys, strafe panel, build/runner/record path), off by default; title card overlays the live spawn, lifts on any key or run start, never consumes input; cream sheets + ink type + orange edge for menus/finish/toasts; HUD numbers cream with ink outline; layout inside a centred 16:9 safe frame for ultrawide. DPITexture exists in 4.7 for crisp icons.
Next: scripts/r18_ui_theme.gd, r18_hud.gd, r18 style panel, wordmark shader; r17_main swap + F9; project version r18; tools/r18-pack-probe.gd (r17 probe adapted, taps F9 before telemetry text checks) and tools/package-r18.py; after-suites; stills at 3 res + mid-run; look/ui-r18/index.html (gitignored images); export to ~/.local/share/foldrunner/spillway-r18/; Sol screenshot review; ff feat/foldrunner-me-build.

author: agent:claude
text:
The new Spillway interface renders in the game for the first time; layout fixes are in progress and nothing has been re-verified yet.

Commit 2b? see git log on feat/spillway-ui ("feat: spillway r18 interface first pass, unverified").
Files: scripts/r18_ui_theme.gd (fonts/colours/menu theme, DPITexture svg icons, safe_frame 16:9, text_width), scripts/r18_hud.gd (extends r16_hud; title card, F9 telemetry via set_telemetry, _layout/_make_pause/_make_finish/show_finish overrides, place_look_label), scripts/r18_style_panel.gd, shaders/r18_wordmark.gdshader (channel cut), scripts/r17_main.gd (_install_hud swap after super._ready, F9 in _input, --ui-telemetry, look label text "Look C · L"/"original R16 look · L", window title R18), project.godot version 2026.11.09-r18.
First 1920x1080 after-stills (~/.cache/spillway-r18/shots/after) showed: pause sheet good; finish card good; title works but needed a stronger scrim; intro card collapsed (fixed: text_width-based wrap, uncommitted then committed in this commit); outlines too thick for small text (now 2/3/4 by size plus a faint shadow); best line overlapped the clock (fixed); menu order fixed; map heading split into heading + note. Fixes are in this commit but NOT yet re-rendered.
Font test: Bricolage outlines render cleanly (no overlap artefacts), so the hollow look was outline thickness only.
Next: re-render stills at 1920x1080, iterate, then 2560x1440 + 3440x1440 for before and after, mid-run captures (python3 tools/r18-ui-shots.py run --map ... --res 3440x1440), then after-suites: parity (copy parity-before dir setup to parity-after with R17 = new commit, include negative-audit.py) and tests/r17_visual_invariants.gd all 8 maps; write tools/r18-pack-probe.gd (copy of r17 probe, R18 identity, tap F9 before the hud word checks, look label contains "original R16") and tools/package-r18.py (copy of package-r17: branch feat/spillway-ui, BUILD/VERSION/NAME SpillwayR18, MAIN unchanged r17.tscn, PROBE r18); export to ~/.local/share/foldrunner/spillway-r18/; page look/ui-r18/index.html with .gitignore + .gdignore; one Sol review; ff feat/foldrunner-me-build.
